_comment: Reviewed release asset rules (aegis-7zkl). An asset name is {prefix}{tag}{suffix}. The check runs once on the release's own trigger_check_run completion; backstop_seconds after publication is the only time arm (producer runs take 14-80m and v0.19.4 assets landed ~4h after publish, so no short fixed grace). provenance.json is not required: releases before the trusted producer carry none.
